1027.description: A machine press done with one leg at a time, helping you build leg strength and fix imbalances.
instructions: Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to straighten the leg without locking the knee.
Lower back with control.
Keep your hips on the seat. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1091.description: A rollout using suspension handles. It challenges the abs and shoulders.
instructions: Kneel holding the handles close to your chest.
Brace your core.
Push your arms forward as you lean out.
Keep your back flat.
Pull back to the start.
Do not let your hips sag.

1155.description: A one-leg hip hinge with the straps for balance, training the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Hold the handles and stand on one leg.
Soften the standing knee.
Hinge at the hip as the other leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Squeeze the glute to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

1283.description: A two-dumbbell press with your upper back on a stability ball. It trains the chest and shoulders while your core works to keep you balanced.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Slowly walk your feet forward, rolling your body down the ball until your head, neck, and upper back are supported on the ball.
Hold the dumbbells at shoulder level, elbows bent and pointing out to the sides.
Press the dumbbells upward, extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
双脚慢慢向前移动，身体沿着球滚动，直到头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
将哑铃保持在与肩同高的位置，肘部弯曲并指向两侧。
向上推哑铃，充分伸展手臂。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1347.description: A one-arm pulldown on a lever machine that works the lats one side at a time. It helps even out strength between left and right.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handle with an overhand grip and fully extend your arm, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Pull the handle down and across your body towards your opposite hip, squeezing your lat muscle at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return the handle to the starting position, fully extending your arm.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，完全伸展手臂，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
将手柄向下拉，穿过身体向对面的臀部方向拉，在动作底部挤压背阔肌。
慢慢地将手柄返回到起始位置，完全伸展手臂。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1411.description: Sit with your forearms on your thighs or a bench, palms down, and curl a barbell up with your wrists. It strengthens the back of the forearms.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your forearms resting on your thighs, palms facing down.
Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lower the barbell towards the ground by flexing your wrists, keeping your forearms stationary.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly raise the barbell back up by extending your wrists.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，前臂放在大腿上，手掌朝下。
正手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
弯曲手腕，将杠铃降低到地面，保持前臂静止。
在底部停顿片刻，然后通过伸展手腕慢慢将杠铃举起。
重复所需的重复次数。

1539.description: A jump with a barbell on the back where you switch the front and back leg in the air. It builds leg power.
instructions: Rest a light bar on your upper back and take a split stance.
Lower into a shallow lunge.
Jump explosively and switch your legs in the air.
Land softly in the opposite split stance.
Keep your torso upright and continue alternating.

1603.description: A wall squat with a stability ball behind you while holding extra weight. It adds load to a back-supported squat.
instructions: Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall.
Hold your weight at chest level or at your sides.
Step your feet forward and squat as the ball rolls down your back.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Press through your heels to rise back up.

1667.description: A one-arm reverse spider curl, with an overhand grip over a bench. It works the forearms and brachialis.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing down and arm fully extended.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder by flexing your elbow.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 站直，一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝下，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，将哑铃向肩膀方向卷曲。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1731.description: A close grip dumbbell press. It builds the triceps along with the chest.
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Using your thighs to help raise the dumbbells, lift the dumbbells one at a time so that you can hold them in front of you at shoulder width.
Once at shoulder width, rotate your wrists forward so that the palms of your hands are facing away from you. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, slowly lower the dumbbells to your side until they are about level with your chest.
As you exhale, use your triceps to lift the dumbbells back to the starting position. Make sure to use only your triceps and do not use your forearms or biceps to help lift the dumbbells.
After a second pause at the contracted position, repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在平坦的长凳上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
用你的大腿帮助举起哑铃，一次举起一个哑铃，这样你就可以将它们保持在与肩同宽的位置。
一旦与肩同宽，向前旋转手腕，使手掌背向自己。这将是您的起始位置。
当你吸气时，慢慢地将哑铃降低到你的身边，直到它们与你的胸部齐平。
呼气时，用三头肌将哑铃举回到起始位置。确保只使用三头肌，不要使用前臂或二头肌来帮助举起哑铃。
在收缩位置第二次暂停后，重复该动作达到规定的重复次数。

1795.description: Reaching your arms out as you round your upper back stretches the muscles between and around your shoulder blades.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and reach both arms forward at chest height.
Round your upper back and spread your shoulder blades apart as you reach farther.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1859.description: Kneeling cable extension that isolates the triceps by pushing the handle down from head height.
instructions: Attach a rope or bar to a high pulley and kneel facing away.
Hold it overhead with your elbows bent behind your head.
Keep your upper arms still and straighten your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
Return slowly to the start.

1923.description: A partner lifts your straight leg to deepen a relaxed hamstring stretch.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and relax completely.
Have a partner lift one leg by the heel, keeping the knee straight.
Tell your partner to stop when you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Keep your other leg and lower back flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

1987.description: A stretch for the rotator cuff with the arm held low behind the body.
instructions: Stand tall and place one arm behind your back, bent at the elbow.
Hold the wrist with the other hand.
Gently draw the hand away from your body and slightly up.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2115.description: Opens the front of the hips from a kneeling position by pushing the pelvis forward, which also wakes up the glutes.
instructions: Kneel on a soft surface with knees hip-width apart and thighs upright.
Place your hands on your hips or the back of your pelvis.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward.
Keep your ribs down and avoid over-arching your lower back.
Hold for a moment, then return to the start.
Repeat for 8-12 reps.

2307.description: A kick that thrusts the heel out to the side, using hip strength and balance.
instructions: Stand sideways in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee toward your chest.
Extend the leg sideways and push the heel to the target.
Keep your supporting foot turned slightly away.
Pull the leg back and set it down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

2371.description: A weighted russian twist, rotating a weight side to side while leaning back. Works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold the weight with both hands in front of your chest.
Lean back slightly to engage your core muscles.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing the weight towards the right side of your body.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing the weight towards the left side of your body.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地板上。
用双手将重物放在胸前。
稍微向后倾斜以锻炼核心肌肉。
将躯干向右扭转，将重量移至身体右侧。
暂停片刻，然后将躯干向左扭转，将重量移向身体的左侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

2563.description: A row performed while pulling a loaded sled for back and grip strength.
instructions: Attach a rope or handles to a loaded sled.
Hold the rope with your knees slightly bent.
Pull the sled toward you with a rowing motion.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Keep your back flat.
Repeat for the planned distance.

2755.description: A cable leg raise to the side with the toes turned out, targeting the outer hip.
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold a support for balance.
Turn your toes out slightly.
Lift the working leg out to the side.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

2947.description: Rolling the front of the lower leg on a foam roller. It can loosen the muscles beside your shin.
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place the roller under the front of your shin.
Support yourself with your hands on the floor.
Roll slowly up and down the shin muscle.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch legs and keep the pressure comfortable.

3011.description: An incline push-up where you retract your shoulder blades. Strengthens the serratus anterior and upper back.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Place your hands on the bench slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Position your feet on the ground, hip-width apart.
Lower your chest towards the bench, keeping your elbows tucked in.
As you lower, retract your shoulder blades, squeezing your scapulae together.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
将双手放在长凳上，距离略比肩宽。
将双脚放在地面上，距离与臀部同宽。
将胸部向长凳方向降低，保持肘部内收。
当你降低时，缩回肩胛骨，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3075.description: A press with dumbbells held close together that shifts the work toward the triceps and inner chest.
instructions: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand pressed together over your chest.
Keep your palms facing each other.
Lower the dumbbells to your chest with your elbows tucked.
Press back up while keeping the weights touching.
Keep your wrists straight.

3203.description: A half sit-up with the hands held behind the head, like a prisoner. It trains the abs through a short, controlled range.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3331.description: A twisting crunch with your legs lifted straight, making your core work harder through the lever.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs raised straight and hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Rotate to bring one elbow toward the opposite hip.
Keep your legs steady and low back pressed down.
Return slowly and alternate sides.

3395.description: A hamstring curl where your heels slide on a towel over a smooth floor.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your hips.
Keep your hips high throughout.
Move slowly to stay in control.

3459.description: Small upward pulses with your legs raised, targeting the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs pointing to the ceiling.
Place your hands by your sides.
Lift your hips slightly with a small pulse.
Lower and repeat.
Keep movement small.
Do 15-20 pulses.

3523.description: A bodyweight glute bridge with the shoulders on a bench and both feet on the floor. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your back against it and your feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands on the bench beside your hips for support.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then lift your hips off the bench until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳边缘，背靠着长凳，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在臀部旁边的长凳上以获得支撑。
收紧臀肌和腿筋，然后将臀部抬离长凳，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3587.description: Lift one leg while loaded with ankle weight, targeting the glutes and hip extensors.
instructions: Wear ankle weights and get on hands and knees or lie face down.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Raise the weighted leg without swinging.
Pause at the top and squeeze.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

3651.description: Walk forward doing Romanian deadlifts with dumbbells, a balance and hamstring challenge.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand tall.
Hinge at the hips on one leg as you step forward.
Keep your back flat and raise the rear leg.
Stand tall and step into the next rep.
Alternate legs as you move forward.

3715.description: A balance hold on one leg on an unstable bosu ball. It challenges the ankle and hip stabilisers.
instructions: Place a bosu ball dome-up in front of you.
Step onto it with one foot near the center.
Lift your other foot and hold it off the ground.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then switch legs.

3779.description: A skiing motion with the band: swing both arms down and back while hinging at the hips. It works your lats, hips and core.
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and hold a handle in each hand.
Stand with soft knees and arms extended in front of you.
Pull the handles down and back past your hips as you hinge forward.
Return the arms up and stand tall in one smooth motion.
Keep your back flat and move with control.

3971.description: A band raise to the sides while bent forward. It targets the rear delts.
instructions: Stand on the band and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold the band ends with arms hanging.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.

4035.description: A bent over kick-back against a band. The hinged torso gives the glutes and hamstrings a deeper stretch and squeeze.
instructions: Anchor the band low and loop it around one ankle.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, hands on a support.
Extend the working leg back and up against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

4099.description: A half kneeling chest pass motion with a medicine ball that trains pushing power and core stability.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Brace your core and stay tall.
Push the ball forward explosively or against a wall.
Catch it or bring it back to your chest.
Switch the kneeling leg after your set.

4163.description: A wrist curl using cable resistance on one arm. It strengthens the forearm flexors.
instructions: Sit by a low pulley with your forearm resting on your thigh.
Hold the handle with your palm facing up.
Curl your wrist up as far as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly under control.
Complete all reps, then switch arms.

4227.description: A front raise lying on your back using a low cable. It isolates the front delts without any body swing.
instructions: Lie on your back with your head toward a low pulley.
Hold the handle with straight arms by your hips.
Raise your arms in an arc until they point straight up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back toward your thighs.
Keep your ribs down and core braced.

4291.description: A one-legged hip bridge with a dumbbell resting on your hips. It hits the glutes hard and challenges hip stability.
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat, and the other leg extended or raised.
Rest a dumbbell across your hips and hold it steady.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glute at the top for a second.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch legs.

4355.description: A triceps pushdown using a V bar on a high cable, a classic for the back of the arms.
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley and grip the V bar with elbows at your sides.
Keep your torso upright and slightly forward.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Let the bar rise slowly, elbows still.

4419.description: An easier lying leg raise that trains the lower abs. Bent knees reduce the strain on the lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your sides.
Bend your knees slightly and press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until your hips flex to about 90 degrees.
Lower them slowly without arching your back.
Stop short of the floor and repeat.

4483.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the mid chest (sternal pectoralis major). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your mid chest (sternal pectoralis major) while leaning on a wall or lying face down.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4547.description: A combo of a hip hinge and a squat that warms up and strengthens the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands behind your head.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Come back up to standing.
Bend your knees and sink into a squat with your chest tall.
Stand up and repeat the hinge, then the squat.
Keep your core braced and your weight over your mid-foot.

4611.description: Self-massage with a ball on the back of the shoulder to ease tension in the rear delts.
instructions: Place a small ball between the back of your shoulder and a wall.
Lean in until you feel moderate pressure.
Roll slowly up, down and sideways over the rear deltoid.
Pause on tight spots for a few breaths.
Switch to the other shoulder.

4675.description: A bouncy side lunge that stretches the inner thighs and trains light explosive movement.
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and sit into a side lunge.
Straighten the other leg and feel the inner thigh stretch.
Push off to hop to the other side.
Continue alternating at a controlled pace.

4739.description: An explosive pull that takes dumbbells from the hang position to your shoulders. It builds power in the hips and back.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells and hinge until they hang just above your knees.
Keep your back flat and arms straight.
Drive your hips forward and shrug as you pull the weights up.
Drop under them and catch at your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower to the hang and repeat.

4803.description: Lying or seated barbell press where the bar travels from a high position over the head, isolating the triceps through a long range.
instructions: Set up with a barbell held at arm's length above your head, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead or just behind your head.
Keep your elbows from flaring out.
Extend your arms to press the bar back to the start.

4867.description: Seated butterfly pose with gentle knee flapping. It loosens the inner thighs and hips.
instructions: Sit with the soles of your feet together.
Hold your feet.
Gently flap your knees up and down.
Keep your spine tall.
Continue for 30 seconds.

4931.description: A calf stretch done on one leg at a time. It lengthens the lower leg muscles.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and heel on the floor.
Place your hands on the wall.
Lean forward with a straight back leg.
Feel the stretch in the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

5059.description: Pressing the heel down toward the floor to lengthen the calf. It helps ankle flexibility.
instructions: Stand with the ball of one foot on a low step or wall, heel on the floor.
Hold something for balance.
Press your heel gently down and back.
Keep your knee straight for the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

5123.description: Pull a bar down to your chest with an underhand grip. It works the lats and gets the biceps more involved.
instructions: Sit at a pulldown station with palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and together.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.

5187.description: A burpee with a push-up that finishes in a long forward jump. It is a tough full-body conditioning move.
instructions: Stand tall, then squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back and do one push-up.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Explode into a long jump forward.
Land softly with bent knees and go into the next rep.

5315.description: A step-up with a cable that is set to put more work on the glutes. It builds strength in the hips.
instructions: Hold the cable handle and stand facing a step.
Place one foot on the step.
Lean slightly forward from the hips.
Drive through the heel to stand up.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

5379.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the back of the shoulder. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your rear shoulder.
Place the roller under the back of the shoulder and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly along the back of the shoulder.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5635.description: Bent-arm lateral raise that shifts load onto the side delts.
instructions: Stand with dumbbells and elbows bent.
Raise your elbows out to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your torso still.

5699.description: A side bend done on a 45 degree bench that trains the obliques through a long range of motion.
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree bench, lying on your side with your feet anchored.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your upper body toward the floor.
Bend up sideways by contracting your oblique.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

5891.description: A deep lunge with the back heel lifted and arms overhead. Strengthens the legs and stretches the hips.
instructions: Step one foot back into a long lunge with your back heel lifted.
Bend your front knee to about 90 degrees over your ankle.
Sweep your arms overhead and stand tall.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Step forward and switch legs.

6019.description: A prone hold that lifts the chest and legs, building lower back endurance.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs a few inches.
Keep your neck neutral.
Squeeze your glutes and hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly.

6147.description: An alternating hammer curl done with strict form, keeping your body still. It builds the biceps, brachialis and forearms.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with your palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up without swinging.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your torso still.

6211.description: A pedalling crunch where you bring each elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Twist to bring one elbow to the opposite knee.
Extend the other leg.
Switch sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

6787.description: A simple check of how far the hip turns outward. You do it gently to see your range.
instructions: Sit or lie with the knee bent 90 degrees.
Keep the thigh still.
Swing the lower leg inward so the hip rotates outward.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
Repeat on the other leg.

7107.description: A machine press done with one leg at a time. It helps fix strength imbalances between legs.
instructions: Sit in the machine and put one foot on the platform.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press the platform away until your leg is almost straight.
Lower slowly until your knee bends to about 90 degrees.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

7235.description: A light dumbbell rotation that trains the rear shoulder and rotator cuff.
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow tucked and bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your upper arm against your side.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
Return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

7555.description: Jumping jack paired with a high knee for a lively cardio drill.
instructions: Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out and raise your arms overhead.
Jump back in and bring one knee high.
Alternate knees each rep.
Stay light on your feet.

7619.description: A burpee that finishes with a jumping jack. It raises your heart rate and works the whole body.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor and push up, or skip the push-up if you prefer.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Jump up, spreading your arms and legs like a jumping jack, then repeat.

7747.description: Lying face down, you raise light dumbbells while bending the elbows into a W shape. It works the rear delts and the upper back.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench or the floor with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Lift your arms out and up into a W shape.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

8195.description: A gentle seated side bend that works the obliques and loosens the sides. Easy to do at a desk.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Place one hand behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the floor.
Return to upright using your side muscles.
Repeat on the other side.

8899.description: Raising the arms in a Y shape against cable tension works the lower traps and shoulders. It supports healthy overhead movement.
instructions: Stand facing the low cable with a handle in each hand or one handle at a time.
Start with your arms low and a slight bend in your elbows.
Lift your arms up and out to form a Y shape.
Keep your thumbs pointing up and your ribs down.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Avoid shrugging toward your ears.

9411.description: An alternating calf raise with the knees bent, using a chair for balance. It works the soleus one side at a time.
instructions: Stand behind a chair and hold it with both hands.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise one heel as high as possible.
Lower it slowly.
Raise the other heel.
Keep alternating without locking your knees.

9603.description: A controlled step-up and down drill often used for knee strength. It trains the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand with one foot on a low step.
Lower the other foot toward the floor with control.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Touch the floor lightly.
Drive back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

10051.description: A lunge done with a narrow stance and no weight. It targets the quads and glutes while challenging balance.
instructions: Stand with feet close together and hands on your hips or in front of you.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
Switch legs and repeat.

10115.description: A close grip press on a decline bench that loads the triceps and lower chest together.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and grab the bar with hands about shoulder width apart.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your lower chest with locked elbows.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping elbows tucked close.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows and use a spotter.

10563.description: Press one knee forward toward a box with your foot flat to stretch the calf. It improves ankle flexibility.
instructions: Place a foot flat a short distance from a box or step.
Keep your heel down.
Push your knee forward to touch the box.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a calf stretch.
Switch legs and repeat.

10755.description: A single-leg calf hop with a step box nearby for balance. It trains ankle power with extra stability.
instructions: Stand beside a step box and rest a hand lightly on it for balance.
Lift one foot off the floor.
Hop up using mostly your ankle and calf.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Keep the hops small and quick.
Switch legs after your set.

10819.description: A calf raise in a split stance, with most work on the front leg. It trains the calf with balance support.
instructions: Stand in a split stance, front foot flat and back toes lightly touching the floor.
Keep most weight on the front leg.
Rise onto the ball of the front foot.
Pause at the top.
Lower the heel slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

11267.description: A standing cable move where you pull your leg across your body. It works the inner thigh.
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley on the far side and hold something for balance.
Stand tall with your core tight.
Sweep your working leg across in front of the other leg.
Squeeze your inner thigh.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

11651.description: Gentle kneecap sliding while seated that loosens the tissue around the knee and warms up the front of the thigh.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair or bench with one leg extended and the thigh muscle relaxed.
Place your fingertips or the heel of your hand on the edges of your kneecap.
Gently glide the kneecap side to side and up and down in small, slow motions.
Keep the quad relaxed and stay in a comfortable range with no sharp pain.
Move for 30-60 seconds, then switch legs.

11715.description: A horizontal row hanging under rope handles that works the back and grip.
instructions: Set ropes at about waist height and lie under them, holding the ends.
Keep your body straight from heels to head, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

0003.description: A bicycle-style crunch where opposite elbow and knee meet while the other leg straightens. Hits the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your hands placed behind your head.
Lift your legs off the ground and bend your knees at a 90-degree angle.
Bring your right elbow towards your left knee while simultaneously straightening your right leg.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement on the opposite side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee while straightening your left leg.
Continue alternating sides in a pedaling motion for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双手放在脑后。
将双腿抬离地面，并以 90 度角弯曲膝盖。
将右肘靠近左膝盖，同时伸直右腿。
返回起始位置，在另一侧重复该动作，将左肘拉向右膝盖，同时伸直左腿。
继续交替进行蹬踏动作，达到所需的重复次数。

0067.description: A one-handed snatch that takes the bar from the floor to overhead in one fast pull. Needs power and coordination.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outwards.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your hips into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles, driving the barbell upwards.
As the barbell reaches chest level, pull it upwards with your arm, keeping it close to your body.
Rotate your elbow under the barbell and extend your arm fully overhead, locking out your elbow.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
正手握住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
弯曲膝盖，降低臀部至下蹲位置，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
爆发性伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝，将杠铃向上推。
当杠铃到达胸部水平时，用手臂将其向上拉，使其靠近身体。
将肘部旋转到杠铃下方，并将手臂完全伸过头顶，锁定肘部。
以受控的方式将杠铃降低回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0131.description: A lying twist with bent knees while your upper back is on a stability ball. It trains the obliques and trunk control.
instructions: Lie with your upper back on a stability ball and your knees bent at 90 degrees.
Extend your arms out to the sides for balance.
Rotate your knees and hips slowly to one side.
Pause briefly.
Bring them back through the centre and rotate to the other side.
Keep your shoulders square to the ceiling.

0195.description: A cable curl with the upper arms resting on a preacher pad. The pad stops swinging so the biceps do the work.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the preacher curl pad is at chest height.
Sit on the preacher curl bench and place your upper arms on the pad, gripping the cable attachment with an underhand grip.
Keep your back straight and your elbows tucked in at your sides.
Slowly curl the cable attachment up towards your shoulders, squeezing your biceps at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the cable attachment back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整绳索机，使牧师弯举垫处于胸部高度。
坐在牧师弯举凳上，将上臂放在垫子上，用反手抓住电缆附件。
保持背部挺直，肘部放在身体两侧。
慢慢地将电缆附件向肩膀方向卷曲，在动作的最高点挤压二头肌。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将电缆附件放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0259.description: A push-up with the hands placed close together under the chest. It shifts more of the load onto the triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands placed close together, directly under your shoulders.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手并拢，位于肩膀正下方。
收紧核心，将身体降低到地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0323.description: A one-arm lateral raise on an incline bench. It isolates the side delt, one arm at a time.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand, resting it on your thigh.
Lean forward and position your upper arm against the inside of your thigh.
Raise the dumbbell to the side, keeping your arm slightly bent and your palm facing down.
Continue lifting until your arm is parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 坐在上斜凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，将其放在大腿上。
身体前倾，将上臂靠在大腿内侧。
将哑铃举到一侧，保持手臂稍微弯曲，手掌朝下。
继续抬起，直到手臂与地板平行。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0387.description: Seated, you raise one dumbbell at a time to the front. It builds the front of the shoulders without much body swing.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body and arms extended down by your sides.
Keeping your arms straight, raise one dumbbell in front of you until it is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm.
Alternate between arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体，手臂向下伸展到身体两侧。
保持双臂伸直，将一只哑铃举至身前，直至其与地面平行。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述步骤。
双臂交替进行所需的重复次数。

0451.description: You curl an EZ bar with an overhand grip. It works the biceps, the muscle under them and the forearms.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Curl the barbell upwards by contracting your biceps, while exhaling.
Continue to raise the barbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the barbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Slowly begin to bring the barbell back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住 ez 杠铃。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
通过收缩二头肌将杠铃向上卷曲，同时呼气。
继续举起杠铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且杠铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气时慢慢开始将杠铃拉回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0579.description: Seated at a lever machine, you pull the handles down toward your chest. Builds the lats and upper back.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your knees under the pads and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Sit upright with your chest lifted and your shoulders back, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back.
Engage your lats and pull the handles down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，膝盖位于垫子下方，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
坐直，胸部抬起，肩膀向后，保持下背部轻微的拱形。
收紧背阔肌，将手柄向下拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0643.description: Reaching one arm overhead and bending the elbow, you pull gently on it with the other hand. Stretches the triceps and shoulder.
instructions: Stand or sit upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm overhead, bending at the elbow so that your hand reaches towards the opposite shoulder blade.
With your other hand, gently pull the elbow of the extended arm towards the opposite side of your head, feeling a stretch in your triceps.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the other side.
instructionsZh: 站立或坐直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将一只手臂伸过头顶，弯曲肘部，使手伸向对面的肩胛骨。
用另一只手轻轻地将伸出的手臂的肘部拉向头部的另一侧，感受三头肌的拉伸。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒，然后放松。
在另一侧重复。

0707.description: A side-lying crunch that brings the ribs toward the hip. It works the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift your upper body and legs toward each other.
Squeeze your side.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

0771.description: A wrist curl with the smith bar held behind the body. It strengthens the forearms and grip.
instructions: Stand facing the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your elbows close to your body.
Slowly curl your wrists upwards, bringing the barbell towards your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面对史密斯机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
保持背部挺直，肘部靠近身体。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，将杠铃拉向身体。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0835.description: A back extension over a stability ball while holding a weight. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Position yourself face down on a stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your feet against a wall for stability.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, extending your back until your body forms a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将自己面朝下放在稳定球上，臀部放在球上，双脚靠在墙上以保持稳定。
将双手放在脑后或交叉放在胸前。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的上半身抬离球，伸展你的背部，直到你的身体形成一条直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0963.description: A wide lunge with arms stretched to the sides. It strengthens the legs and builds stamina.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and turn your front foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Turn your head to look over the front hand.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.
